item.title: Toward Estimating the Crop Coefficient of Vineyards Using a Smartphone Camera
item.description: We developed a smartphone camera and computer vision-based method to estimate vineyard crop coefficient by measuring shaded area, providing a low-cost, accessible alternative to Paso Panel measurements.

item.title: Smartphone-Based Irrigation Information in Vineyards
item.description: We developed a simple and fast way to estimate crop water needs in vineyards using just a smartphone and computer vision instead of expensive sensors.
